title: KsamDeal — E-commerce Platform
description: KsamDeal is an e-commerce platform designed to make online shopping simple, convenient, and affordable. Discover a variety of quality products, explore great deals, and enjoy a smooth shopping experience—all in one place.
problem: Build a simple, convenient and affordable online shopping experience where users can discover products and find great deals without unnecessary complexity.
solution: A responsive frontend e-commerce experience with structured product data, category browsing, search, filtering and shopping-cart interactions.
process: Plan the shopping information architecture, structure product data, build the responsive interface, add search/filter/cart interactions, and refine the experience across screen sizes.
challenges: Keeping product discovery, filtering, dynamic rendering and cart behavior intuitive while maintaining a clean responsive interface.
tagline: Shop Smart. Find Great Deals. Choose KsamDeal.

title: ShareSphere — Content Sharing Platform
description: ShareSphere is a simple and user-friendly platform designed to make sharing and discovering content easier. Connect with others, share valuable resources, explore new ideas, and build a community where information can be shared effortlessly.
tagline: Share ideas. Discover resources. Build a community.
problem: Make it easier for people to share useful content, discover new ideas and resources, and connect around information.
solution: A simple, user-friendly platform focused on effortless content sharing, resource discovery, connection and community building.
process: Design a clear content-sharing flow, organize discovery around useful resources, build an approachable interface, and refine the experience for smooth community interaction.
challenges: Keeping content sharing and discovery simple while creating an interface that encourages connection and community participation.
